findings.evidence:
Legacy v1 encoding (first parent) persisted lock/unlock job args as `LockTablesArg` with CamelCase JSON keys via `Args: []any{arg}` (e.g. `75483d8f^:pkg/ddl/executor.go:5321-5332`, `75483d8f^:pkg/ddl/executor.go:5464-5472`).
This commit switches DDL worker decoding to `model.GetLockTablesArgs` (`pkg/ddl/table_lock.go:26-38`, `pkg/ddl/table_lock.go:226-238`), where v1 decoding unmarshals into `model.LockTablesArgs` that uses snake_case JSON tags (`pkg/meta/model/job_args.go:1201-1224`). Go `encoding/json` uses the tag name as the only match key and only case-folds (no camelCase↔snake_case normalization), so old persisted keys like `LockTables` will not populate `json:"lock_tables"` (see `$GOROOT/src/encoding/json/encode.go:typeFields` and `$GOROOT/src/encoding/json/decode.go` using `foldName`).
With zero-value decoded args, `onLockTables` may never reach `FinishTableJob` when `len(args.LockTables)==0` (`pkg/ddl/table_lock.go:59-101`), and `onUnlockTables` may finish immediately without unlocking anything when `len(args.UnlockTables)==0` (`pkg/ddl/table_lock.go:234-237`).
findings.fix: For `JobVersion1` lock/unlock jobs, keep backward-compatible decoding of the legacy `LockTablesArg` JSON shape (CamelCase keys) and convert into `model.LockTablesArgs` before execution; alternatively implement `UnmarshalJSON` on `model.LockTablesArgs` to accept both legacy CamelCase keys and current snake_case keys (and consider handling the `is_cleanup:omitempty` tag typo at the same time).
findings.impact: Upgrading TiDB while an `ActionLockTable`/`ActionUnlockTable` job created by an older binary is still in the DDL queue can cause the job to be stuck (blocking subsequent DDL) or to “succeed” without actually unlocking, leaving metadata table locks behind and impacting availability.
findings.later_fix_evidence: Checked `upstream/master:pkg/meta/model/job_args.go:1072-1093`: `LockTablesArgs` still uses `json:"lock_tables"` (and `is_cleanup:omitempty`) and v1 decoding is still a plain `json.Unmarshal` via `job.decodeArgs(a)`, with no legacy-key compatibility handling.
findings.verify: Add a unit test that constructs a v1 job whose `RawArgs` is marshaled from the pre-change `LockTablesArg` (CamelCase keys) and assert `model.GetLockTablesArgs` returns the correct values; include a regression test that `onLockTables`/`onUnlockTables` makes progress and unlocks when fed such a job.
findings.what: `JobVersion1` lock/unlock table DDL jobs are not backward-compatible across upgrade: this commit changes the persisted JSON field names for the lock/unlock args (CamelCase → snake_case tags), so older in-flight jobs may decode to empty args and then either never finish (lock) or finish without unlocking (unlock).

subject: ddl: args v2 for lock/unlock/repair table and recover table/schema (#56194)
summary: Adds args-v2 helpers/types for lock/unlock/repair and recover table/schema jobs and wires DDL/executor/worker paths to use them; main remaining risk is a v1 on-disk job-args incompatibility for lock/unlock jobs due to new `LockTablesArgs` JSON tags breaking decoding of older persisted jobs.
